title: Follow a delivery decision
summary: Trace a dated supply gap into frozen strategies, distinctive crops, clearer optional sound and sourced News context.

changes.title: A playable decision with traceable evidence
changes.description: Inspect the actual booked-order records, edit exact assumptions, run three numerical strategies and compare one policy at a time. Biological maturity and calculation waiting use separate clocks. Saved results retain their own baseline and mission.

changes.title: Recognizable original crops
changes.description: Eighteen revised illustrations distinguish leaf shapes, stems and growth habits across ten crop profiles and four stage sequences. Independent compact-size and grayscale reviews prompted specific mustard, kale and pak choi revisions.

changes.title: Optional sound with test and retry
changes.description: A stronger original mix, separate channels and a test tone address the previously quiet audio. Completion, shortfall, withheld acceptance and failure have distinct cues. Every visit starts silent. Signal/browser review is recorded; physical-device listening remains untested.

changes.title: News supports the seven-agent council
changes.description: Browse cached SFA and regional headline metadata with separate source dates and explicit missing future-event coverage. A supporting News scout freezes evidence for decisions and paid advisor interpretation; headlines never change farm quantities automatically. Reddit and restricted community sources remain visibly unavailable.

changes.title: Earlier editions preserved after hosting review
changes.description: Retain separate Fly instances: equal-capacity configurations offer essentially no price saving, and cheaper shared sizes require unverified capacity reductions. Earlier images, sessions and saved records remain independent.
